content: Arize Phoenix official docs describe Phoenix as an open-source AI observability/evaluation platform that accepts OTLP traces, supports Python/TypeScript/Java and common framework/provider integrations, and provides tracing, evals, datasets, experiments, and prompt management. Self-hosting docs say Phoenix is free to self-host with no feature gates and can keep data entirely inside the user's infrastructure, including air-gapped deployments; CLI docs support local pip install plus phoenix serve.
